scientific_integrity: The stated formulas were derived from exact singular-value blocks and all inequalities were factored; independent audit is unperformed and no uniqueness beyond mathematical class exhaustion is attributed to database partitioning.
scientific_limitations: The result holds for unweighted crown graphs with integer n≥4 and exactly three noise-free pinned leaders. Not a theorem for weighted, perturbed, noisy or arbitrary bipartite graphs; the n=3 cycle case is prior literature. A specialist overlapping theorem may exist outside the inspected accessible literature.
title: Strict three-leader coherence hierarchy on crown graphs
